messages:
Jamie: OK team — quick shout: we just crossed 3.14159265 billion inference tokens this quarter. tiny pi party? :pie: :confetti_ball:
Mike: wait what. wow. incredible. massive kudos to infra and runtime folks. :raised_hands:
Sophia: OMG that’s wild. congrats everyone!! also brings up my ancient promise of bringing pies if we hit a silly number :-D
Anna: can we get enamel pins that say "Pi-lot" or something cheesy like that? :pin:
Praveen: I will handle stickers + pins — submitting a quick budget request now. cc @finance.
Ellie: virtual toast for remote folks at 4pm PT? quick 10m hangout + confetti gifs? :tada:
Lee: poll time — vote with emoji: :cake: for cake, :pie: for pie, :ramen: for ramen truck, :star: for stickers only
Mike: :pie:
Sophia: :pie:
Anna: :star: (I want both but will settle for stickers)
Praveen: :ramen: (I mean, food)
Ellie: :pie:
Jamie: also — tiny braggy metric for the #metrics channel:
```
total_tokens_served=3141592650
qtr_growth=2.4x
p95_latency=42ms
```
Sophia: p95 42ms yayyy. can we gif that? :clap:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: celebration toast @ 2026-03-23 16:00 PT — channel: #random (automated)
Jamie: thanks deploy-bot :raised_hands: ok folks, pie wins so office pies on Friday. remote care packages for those not local. special enamel pin prototype arriving next week. tiny victory lap but huge credit to everyone.
Ellie: can someone make a silly banner? I’ll pin it to the channel when done. :camera_flash:
Praveen: putting vendor options in Confluence now, will @ops for pickup logistics.
Mike: still not over 3.1415G, this is peak nerd celebration and I love it. :nerd_face:
